1030111934459326464.a: 3/I cut gums and preservatives and added fruit high in antioxidants and sugar to my diet. My weight began dropping by 10 pounds/mo immediately until I had lost 120 pounds and it stabilized there.

1030111939006001152.a: 5/Worse than that, PUFAs are water soluble and go straight into your bloodstream. Cold press oils, etc passthrough. When free radicals from industrial PUFA production and later frying are in your blood they can cause you're blood vessels to swell spiking your blood pressure.

1030111942420119554.a: 7/ This is simply a part of a larger trend. Poor people are kept poor. Food choices and nearly every other choice comes with a poor tax. We simply cannot allow money to drive decisions that harm #humanity any longer. #humanity will be extinct replaced by Morlocks in castles.

1030114807243001856.a: 8/ I was lucky and met a friend who is a nutritionist (RDN) at a retirement home who took the time to help me change my diet. Most of my issues were similar to those she and her patients have experienced.
